title: Four CSE faculty receive National Science Foundation CAREER Awards
summary_en: Four University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering researchers have received National Science Foundation (NSF) Faculty Early Career Development (CAREER) Awards to pursue innovative research and educate the next generation of scientists and engineers.
title_cn: Four CSE faculty receive National Science Foundation CAREER Awards

title: Pass it on: How CSE mentors help students build their futures
summary_en: Mentorship connects University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering (CSE) students with alumni and professionals who can help them navigate careers, build confidence and prepare for the workforce — and gives mentors a meaningful way to pass what they’ve learned to the next generation.
title_cn: Pass it on: How CSE mentors help students build their futures

title: Lasers and gold — and a doctorate — draw graduate student to Minnesota
summary_en: After she earning her Ph.D. from the University of Minnesota in May, MaKenna Koble was named among the prestigious Arnold O. Beckman 2026 Postdoctoral Fellows in Chemical Instrumentation.
title_cn: Lasers and gold — and a doctorate — draw graduate student to Minnesota
